last.verdict: Margins and cash burn improved sharply, but sales keep shrinking and the fourth-quarter outlook points to a further drop.

takeaways.label: Weaker sales ahead
takeaways.text: Fourth-quarter revenue is guided to $54-59 million, below the $64.5 million just reported, which was down 8.1% from a year ago.

takeaways.label: Margins at five-year high
takeaways.text: Gross margin hit 19.3% versus 7.4% a year ago, as cost per pound fell 10.1% and average prices rose 3.2%.

takeaways.label: U.S. demand still falling
takeaways.text: U.S. retail volume fell 20.8% on lost shelf space and weak category demand. Europe-led international retail grew 13.3%, but international restaurant sales fell 19.4%.

takeaways.label: Cash burn slows, debt remains
takeaways.text: Nine-month cash use was $37.3 million versus $101.2 million a year ago. Cash is $169.3 million against $313.9 million of debt, with $14.5 million of notes due March 2027.

history.verdict: Revenue beat, but a weak Q3 outlook and wider core losses sent shares down.

reasons.label: Weak Q3 outlook
reasons.text: Q3 revenue guided to $60-65 million, below Wall Street's roughly $65.6 million estimate.

reasons.label: Wider core loss
reasons.text: Adjusted EBITDA loss widened to $27.7 million from $24.7 million a year ago.

reasons.label: Falling U.S. sales
reasons.text: U.S. revenue fell 14.4% on weak category demand and fewer stores carrying products.
